name: Macmillan Cancer Support
summary: The UK's largest cancer support charity: a phone line with cancer nurses, information and welfare rights advisers, an online community, information centres, volunteer Buddies and grants, learning for the Macmillan nurses and other NHS professionals in its network, and funding for community and end-of-life care.

spending.source: https://www.macmillan.org.uk/dfsmedia/1a6f23537f7f4519bb0cf14c45b2a629/26224-10061/2025-annual-report-and-accounts (Annual Report and Accounts 2025, note 11 p. 106: in-year charitable expenditure £112,056 thousand, year to 31 December 2025, before £11,655 thousand of write-backs of earlier years' grants and £3,760 thousand of discounting, which make the statement of financial activities' £104,161 thousand; fundraising £70,903 thousand excluded. Pounds converted at $1.3175 a pound, the site's 2025 yearly average (facts/fx.json usd_per_gbp_2025, IRS).)
